node.statement: Lemma 3.2 (Pure state in double Schur basis): For |u> in C^d tensor C^r = C^D, the double Schur transform of |u><u|^{tensor n} decomposes as sum_{lambda,mu} |lambda,lambda><mu,mu|_{YY'} tensor |EPR_lambda><EPR_mu|_{PP'} tensor |u_{lambda,lambda}><u_{mu,mu}|_{QQ'}, where tr_{Q'}(|u_{lambda,lambda}><u_{lambda,lambda}|) = dim(lambda) * nu_lambda^d(sigma_u) with sigma_u = tr_2(|u><u|). Proof: Start from Lemma 3.1, use Pi_sym^{n,D} |u>^{tensor n} = |u>^{tensor n}, and decompose using the Schur basis.
